title: Penultimate
description: A collection of vanilla-friendly tweaks that I made for myself.
body:
This is a resource pack that I made for myself to enjoy - aside from my [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) config, it's the only resource pack I use. I've kept it to myself up until now, and I think someone else should get the chance to enjoy it. Thank you for taking that chance.

Full list of changes
- All tiered tools retextured
- Axes, swords, mace and trident given larger models
- Melons, pumpkins and sugar cane updated
- Various item textures updated
- Slimes, magma cubes and creepers retextured
- Spiders, cave spiders, endermites and silverfish retextured
- All ghast variants retextured
- Iron blocks, doors and trapdoors retextured
- Beacon blocks retextured
- Elytra retextured (item and model)
- UI changes: Buttons, HUD bars, hotbar retextured

Oak chest texture borrowed from [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark), used for vanilla chests in this pack - with respect to the Creative Commons license.

Shader used in gallery screenshots: [Super Duper Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/shader/super-duper-vanilla)
